units.source_text: 此时那个侍从已经嫁了大弍的一个亲戚，大约是外甥。

en.t: By this time that attendant had already married a relative of the Senior Assistant Governor, probably his nephew.

units.source_text: 丈夫是要赴筑紫的，当然不肯让她留在京都。

en.t: Her husband was going to Tsukushi, and naturally would not agree to leave her behind in the capital.

units.source_text: 她虽非心愿，也只得随丈夫离京。

en.t: Though it was not what she wished, she had no choice but to leave the capital with him.

units.source_text: 她对末摘花说：“教我抛开小姐，多么伤心呵！”

en.t: She said to Suetsumuhana, "How heartbreaking it is to have to leave you behind, my lady!"
She wanted to persuade her lady to come with her.

units.source_text: 但末摘花还是把希望寄托在离绝已久的源氏公子身上。

en.t: But Suetsumuhana still placed her hopes in Prince Genji, from whom she had long been estranged.

units.source_text: 她心中一直这样想：“今虽如此，但再过几时，他总有一天会想起我来的吧？

en.t: In her heart she kept thinking, "Even though things are like this now, after some time he will surely remember me someday, will he not?

units.source_text: 他对我曾有真心诚意的誓约，只因我身命运不济，以致一时被他遗忘。

en.t: He once made sincere vows to me; it is only because my own fate is unfortunate that I have been forgotten by him for a while.

units.source_text: 将来设有好风吹送消息，他闻知了我的窘况，一定会来访我。”

en.t: If some favorable wind should carry news to him in the future, and he learns of my hardship, he will certainly come to visit me."

units.source_text: 她住宅中一切情况，比从前更加荒凉，简直不成样子了。

en.t: Everything about her residence had grown even more desolate than before, until it was almost beyond recognition.

units.source_text: 但她竭力忍受，所有器物，一草一木也不变卖。

en.t: Yet she endured with all her strength and would not sell any of her furnishings, not even a single blade of grass or tree.

units.source_text: 其坚贞不拔之志，始终如一。

en.t: Her steadfast and unyielding resolve remained the same from beginning to end.

units.source_text: 然而终日啼啼哭哭，悲伤愁叹，弄得容颜憔悴，

en.t: Yet she spent the whole day weeping, grieving, and sighing, until her face became worn and haggard,

units.source_text: 好比山中的樵夫脸上粘住了一粒红果实，其侧影之古怪，

en.t: like a mountain woodcutter with a single red berry stuck to his face, and her profile was so strange

units.source_text: 即使普通人看了也觉难当。

en.t: that even an ordinary person would have found it hard to bear the sight.
Ah, I ought not describe it in any more detail!

units.source_text: 对不起这位小姐，笔者的口过也太重了。

en.t: I must apologize to this lady; the writer's words have gone much too far.

units.source_text: 不久秋尽冬来，生活更加无依无靠了。

en.t: Before long autumn ended and winter came, and her life became still more helpless and unsupported.

units.source_text: 末摘花只在悲叹中茫然度日。

en.t: Suetsumuhana passed her days in a daze, doing nothing but grieving and lamenting.
